primary_risk.statement: Granting vendor access to C3 customer replay traces creates privacy and security exposure risk if controls fail or approvals are bypassed.
mitigations: Require privacy and security dual approval before activation
Include audit ticket reference for all access
Redact customer payloads before export to vendor sandbox
Use least-privilege sandbox path, not direct production token

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval matches the narrow compliant path in access-policy v2.1 and enables operational progress.
Sanitized sample bundle is policy-safe but less useful than P2 when no freeze or incident constraints apply.
Outright denial over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path (P2) exists and is available.
Direct local override token is technically possible but forbidden by policy as it bypasses required approvals and audit logging.

assumption_ledger.note: Privacy review sign-off must be obtained before P2 can be activated.
Security review sign-off must be obtained before P2 can be activated.
No evidence confirms vendor sandbox is configured to receive redacted replay packages.
Audit ticket linkage is required per audit_log_rules.md; prior exception AUD-184 shows precedent.
